title: Bank of Japan Quarterly Schedule of Outright Purchases of JGBs (Oct-Dec 2026), 17:00 JST — the headline monthly total is already published, so the only news is which maturity zone absorbs the cut
source: EST: boj.or.jp, TWO primaries carrying the identical sentence, the more recent one fetched this session. (1) 'Quarterly Schedule of Outright Purchases of Japanese Government Bonds (Competitive Auction Method) (July-September 2026) <Schedule Updates>' (en/mopo/mpmdeci/mpr_2026/mpr260831a.pdf, dated August 31 2026), fetched direct 2026-09-15 (HTTP 200, 127,330 bytes) and its text layer decompressed by this lane: 'The announcement on the quarterly schedule for October through December 2026 will be published on September 30, 2026 at 5 p.m.' (2) The original June 16 2026 schedule (mpr260616a.pdf, HTTP 200, 141,472 bytes, md5 c85426964e8bac4469a3c291871d5191 — byte-identical to the jgb-40y-auction-2026-09-29 sweep's 09-15 fetch) carrying the same sentence verbatim. Structural corroboration, read off boj.or.jp's own Monetary Policy Releases index for 2025 (en/mopo/mpmdeci/mpr_2025/index.htm, fetched direct 2026-09-15, HTTP 200, 45,804 bytes): the October-December 2025 schedule was published 2025-09-30, i.e. the same last-business-day-of-the-quarter slot, one year earlier. Filed `estimate` on two counts, neither of which doubts the date: CONFIRMED_PREFIX in scripts/event-scan-validation.mjs carries `FED:` and no slot for any other central bank (the limit boj-decision-2026-09-18, boj-tankan-2026-10-01 and every JGB auction on this calendar already record), and the event-research lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Checked 2026-09-15
notes: Proposed 2026-09-15 by the jgb-40y-auction-2026-09-29 D-14 pulse (proposals/boj-jgb-purchase-schedule-q4-2026-09-30.from-jgb-40y-auction-2026-09-29.json, read as input and now shadowed by this canonical file); researched the same day (docs/research/events/boj-jgb-purchase-schedule-q4-2026-09-30.md). THE RESEARCH DEMOTES THE PROPOSAL'S PREMISE. The proposal called this 'the first scheduled read on whether a post-hike BoJ trims the ¥150bn/month >25y bucket'. It is not a read on the headline at all: the June 16 2026 MPM's 'Plan for the Outright Purchases of Japanese Government Bonds' (en/mopo/mpmdeci/mpr_2026/k260616b.pdf, HTTP 200, 110,704 bytes, fetched and decoded direct 2026-09-15) ALREADY PUBLISHES the number, in an attachment table that reads 'October-December 2026 | About 2.3 trillion yen' alongside Apr-Jun 2.7, Jul-Sep 2.5, Jan-Mar 2027 2.1 and 'From April 2027 onward | About 2 trillion yen'. The ¥200bn-a-quarter pace was set even earlier, at the June 2025 MPM (k250617b.pdf, 447,514 bytes: 'From April-June 2026 to January-March 2027: about 200 billion yen'), ~15 months before this release. The June 2026 plan also states the Bank 'will not conduct interim assessments of the plan ... in the future' (7-1 vote; TAMURA Naoki dissenting for a LONGER taper to Jan-Mar 2028; UEDA absent), so nothing is scheduled to reopen it. WHAT IS ACTUALLY NEW on 09-30 is the allocation across the six residual-maturity buckets, plus October's auction dates. AND THE SUPER-LONG BUCKET HAS NEVER TAKEN ANY OF IT: five consecutive quarterly schedules parsed cell-by-cell this session (mpr250617a, mpr250930a, mpr251226a, mpr260331a, mpr260616a) put the 'More than 25 years' zone at ¥75bn per auction and ¥150bn a month in EVERY ONE, while the monthly coupon-JGB total fell ¥3.655tn -> ¥2.47tn (-32.4%). Four cuts, ¥1.185tn/month removed, and the >25y contribution to that is exactly zero — so its SHARE of BoJ buying rose 4.10% -> 6.07%. The Jul-Sep 2026 schedule also thinned FREQUENCY, 3 auctions/month to 2 in every zone from 1y to 25y, leaving >25y at its standing 2. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is `low`: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure (`symbols: []`), and the sibling 40-year ledger measured the JGB-super-long-to-US-long-end spillover as a null whose sign does not hold across samples (n=94, t = -1.45 full sample; n=22, t = +1.08 since 2023). Second useful fact from the same primaries: on an MOF auction day the Bank 'will in principle refrain from announcing auctions for the corresponding maturity segments', so there is no BoJ super-long bid on 09-29. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
